# railway_project_token (Resource)

Railway project token scoped to one environment. Use an account or workspace API token to authenticate the provider. Changing the name, project, or environment replaces the token. Import is unsupported because Railway only returns the credential when it is issued.

Terraform redacts the sensitive credential in normal output. Mark any downstream outputs that expose the credential as sensitive. State and saved plans can still contain it, so protect those artifacts with your backend and access controls.

If issuance succeeds but identity lookup fails, the provider saves the credential in partial state. After API access is restored, destroy the failed token resource before applying again. If the issuance response was lost or the API still cannot identify the token, check the project's token settings and revoke the issued token before retrying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_project" "example" {
  name         = "example"
  workspace_id = var.railway_workspace_id

  default_environment = {
    name = "production"
  }
}

resource "railway_project_token" "ci" {
  name           = "CI"
  project_id     = railway_project.example.id
  environment_id = railway_project.example.default_environment.id
}

output "railway_token" {
  value     = railway_project_token.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment the token belongs to.
- `name` (String) Name of the project token.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project the token belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the project token record.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Project token credential issued by Railway.
